note: One kind of Ядро › Дзеркало Discord, instantiated once per mirrorable kind into MirrorStrip. THE KIND NAMES ARE NOT HERE and must never be: they come from the mods that registered the kinds (OZ_MirrorOps.List), so the core neither names another mod's kind nor caps how many there may be. The script writes the kind (MirrorRowKind), its state (MirrorRowState), the server's sentence on what switching it does (MirrorRowNote) and the switch's caption (MirrorRowBtnText), and finds the row of a click by the MirrorRowBtn widget, so the kind travels with the row rather than in a widget name.
